          minLength: 1

          title: Telephone number

            form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country code

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"

## Summary

I implemented optional, region-validated `postcode` support for owners, keeping each concern in its own small unit and reusing the existing region lookup.

**Spec → data flow**
- **`openapi.yml`** — added `postcode` (type string) to the `OwnerFields` schema. Because `Owner` is `allOf OwnerFields`, this makes the field part of both the request DTO (`OwnerFieldsDto`) and the response DTO (`OwnerDto`), and it stays out of the `required` list so it's optional/backward-compatible.
- **`Owner.java`** — added the `postcode` column-mapped field with getter/setter. MapStruct auto-maps it by name in both directions (store on create, return on read).
- **Schema SQL** (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres) — added a `postcode VARCHAR(10)` column to the `owners` table.

**Validation (rejects out-of-range with 400)**
- **`RegionPostcodeTable.java`** (new model, sibling to the existing `CityRegionTable`) — the fixed region→range lookup: NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099; a region with no range accepts any value.
- **`PostcodeValidator.java`** (new `@Component`) — the single "is this postcode valid for this city" check: requires a 4-digit code, resolves the region via the existing `CityRegionTable.regionOf`, and delegates the range decision to `RegionPostcodeTable`.
- **`OwnerFieldsValidator.java`** — injected `PostcodeValidator` and added a `validatePostcode` step that runs only when a postcode is present, rejecting invalid ones as a field error (surfacing as 400 through the existing `@Valid`/advice path, exactly like the telephone/email rules).

The three acceptance tests — valid postcode stored/returned, owner accepted without a postcode, malformed postcode rejected (400) — all pass, and the full build is green.
